version_note: Upstream release/v3 still declares 2.3.0; this snapshot implements native V3 Agent profiles, the request Coordinator and Flow execution. Its version was not relabelled.

jido.reason: This is the exact native V3 Core revision pinned in this SDK's upstream mix.exs.

incompatible_discovered_core_tip.reason: This later Core and its Action beta.21 use a new provider/route/component/Exec contract not implemented by this AI snapshot. The preview uses the coherent native V3 revisions explicitly pinned upstream, not a V2 fallback.

privacy_limit: Protection covers requests admitted after private activation. Previously admitted public work is not retroactively made private by later adoption. OhMyJido managed and own-agent integrations require private activation from startup.
purpose: Immutable native V3 source snapshot; see boundary_patches for any explicit local additions.
inventory_note: files describe the original selected upstream source bytes before explicit local boundary patches.

boundary_patches.change: Request tool selection can only narrow exact declared names and targets; it retains the original forward-context, unsafe-once, retry and effect metadata rather than reconstructing authority from request data.
Opt-in native Agent module privacy, bounded failure/status projection and propagation of the licensed native Exec private-diagnostics option.

Keep exact declared catalog entries and their authority/retry/forward-context metadata when narrowing. Reject added, renamed or replaced targets; bound private transformer failures before native error observation.

Carry authoritative opt-in privacy into existing native Coordinator/Delivery/Exec tasks, protect OTP status and escaping callbacks, and project opaque failure diagnostics before telemetry/log/storage. Successful model/tool values and ordinary native diagnostics remain unchanged. No provider transport or reasoning loop is replaced.

Hand tools a typed identity-only carrier constructed from the authoritative native Agent snapshot. Core intentionally removes prepared Plugin inputs after commit; this carrier preserves only Agent module and ID without copying unrelated Plugin resources, private host grants, or request/model input. Native request Coordinator, model transport and tool interception remain unchanged.

Wait for the declared native tool module to compile before deriving its public name. This removes a compile-order-dependent dotted-module fallback for valid tools while retaining ToolCatalog name, schema and execution-policy validation.

Add an optional declared-interceptor lifecycle callback pair. Build its observer from the full trusted native ToolAttempt context before forward-context narrowing, attach it only to the existing target Exec options, and invoke callbacks directly with existing private/error containment. Native controller proofs and opaque tokens pass through unchanged; lifecycle receipts cannot replace execution results. Profiles without the pair retain their original path.

Preserve caller req_http_options, including a host-owned Finch instance, when installing the native MockLLM gateway defaults. Fixture retry/receive-timeout defaults remain authoritative; unrelated caller HTTP settings are retained. The actual ReqLLM HTTP/SSE transport and native script execution remain unchanged.
